message: The other day, as I was stocking up for what they said might be a big storm, I found my old board games buried under a pile of dust and forgotten memories. We spent the evening huddled around the table, laughing and competing over the last piece of cake—not a screen in sight. It reminded me that when the weather gets wild, sometimes the best prep is just having a little fun together. Do you have a favorite low-tech activity for stormy days?
